points.title: 贵族出身
points.description: 阿瑟·韦尔斯利出生于爱尔兰都柏林的一个盎格鲁-爱尔兰贵族家庭。他是加勒特·韦尔斯利的第五子，家世显赫但并非长子，因此没有继承家族头衔的期望。少年时期在伊顿公学接受教育，但因家庭经济问题而提前离校。这段经历塑造了他务实、坚韧的性格，也为他日后在军政两界的成功奠定了基础。他的家庭背景使他能够进入英国上流社会，获得军事和政治机会。
points.descriptionEn: Arthur Wellesley was born in Dublin, Ireland into an Anglo-Irish noble family. As the fifth son of Garrett Wellesley, he had no expectation of inheriting the family title. He was educated at Eton College but left early due to family financial difficulties. This experience shaped his practical and resilient character, laying the foundation for his later success in both military and political careers. His aristocratic background provided him with access to British high society, creating opportunities for military and political advancement.

points.title: 军旅起步
points.description: 1787年，韦尔斯利通过家族关系获得陆军少尉军衔，开始在皇家爱尔兰团服役。他迅速展现出军事才能，被任命为副官。1790年代，他参与了爱尔兰的政治动荡，镇压了1798年的爱尔兰起义。这段经历使他熟悉了军事指挥和殖民统治的复杂性。他还学习了法语和军事战略，为后来的欧洲战场做准备。这一时期，他从一个普通军官逐渐成长为有能力的军事指挥官。
points.descriptionEn: In 1787, Wellesley obtained a commission as an ensign through family connections and began serving in the 33rd Regiment of Foot. He quickly demonstrated military talent and was appointed as an aide-de-camp. During the 1790s, he was involved in suppressing political unrest in Ireland, including the 1798 Irish Rebellion. This experience familiarized him with the complexities of military command and colonial rule. He also studied French and military strategy, preparing for future European campaigns. During this period, he evolved from a regular officer into a capable military commander.

points.title: 印度战功
points.description: 1796年，韦尔斯利被派往印度服役，在第四次英迈战争中表现出色。1803年，他在阿瑟斯战役中击败了马拉塔联盟的军队，这场胜利确立了英国在印度的统治地位。他在印度采用了灵活的战术，注重情报收集和后勤保障，这些经验成为他日后军事生涯的重要财富。在印度期间，他还学习了当地语言和文化，展现了适应不同环境的能力。印度的成功使他获得了晋升和声誉，为他返回欧洲后担任更高职务奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1796, Wellesley was sent to serve in India, where he distinguished himself during the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War. In 1803, he defeated the forces of the Maratha Confederacy at the Battle of Assaye, a victory that established British dominance in India. He employed flexible tactics, emphasizing intelligence gathering and logistical support, experiences that became valuable assets in his later military career. During his time in India, he also learned local languages and cultures, demonstrating his ability to adapt to different environments. His success in India earned him promotions and reputation, laying the foundation for his higher positions upon returning to Europe.

points.title: 半岛战争
points.description: 1808年，韦尔斯利被派往伊比利亚半岛，领导英国和盟军对抗拿破仑的军队。他采用游击战术与正规战相结合的方式，成功抵御了法军的多次进攻。1812年，他在萨拉曼卡战役中取得决定性胜利，解放了马德里。1813年，他在维多利亚战役中彻底击败了约瑟夫·波拿巴的军队，迫使法军撤出西班牙。半岛战争持续六年，韦尔斯利的坚韧和战术智慧使他赢得了'铁公爵'的称号。这场战争不仅削弱了拿破仑的力量，也使韦尔斯利成为欧洲最杰出的军事将领之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1808, Wellesley was sent to the Iberian Peninsula to lead British and allied forces against Napoleon's armies. He employed a combination of guerrilla tactics and conventional warfare, successfully repelling multiple French offensives. In 1812, he achieved a decisive victory at the Battle of Salamanca, liberating Madrid. In 1813, he completely defeated Joseph Bonaparte's forces at the Battle of Vitoria, forcing the French to withdraw from Spain. The Peninsular War lasted six years, and Wellesley's resilience and tactical skill earned him the nickname 'Iron Duke.' This campaign not only weakened Napoleon's forces but also established Wellesley as one of Europe's greatest military commanders.

points.title: 滑铁卢战役
points.description: 1815年，拿破仑从厄尔巴岛返回法国，重掌政权。威灵顿公爵被任命为反法联军总司令之一，与普鲁士的布吕歇尔元帅合作，在比利时滑铁卢与拿破仑决战。6月18日，威灵顿在滑铁卢战役中坚守阵地，顶住了法军的多次猛攻，直到布吕歇尔的援军赶到。最终，联军取得了决定性胜利，彻底终结了拿破仑的政治生涯。这场战役使威灵顿成为欧洲最著名的军事家之一，也为他赢得了崇高的国际声誉。滑铁卢战役被视为欧洲历史上最具决定性的战役之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1815, Napoleon returned from exile on Elba and regained power. The Duke of Wellington was appointed as one of the commanders of the Allied forces, working in cooperation with Prussian Marshal Blücher to confront Napoleon at Waterloo in Belgium. On June 18, Wellington held his position against multiple fierce French attacks until Blücher's reinforcements arrived. The Allied forces ultimately achieved a decisive victory, completely ending Napoleon's political career. This battle established Wellington as one of Europe's most famous military commanders and earned him international prestige. The Battle of Waterloo is considered one of the most decisive battles in European history.

points.title: 政治生涯
points.description: 滑铁卢战役后，威灵顿转入政治领域，担任英国首相(1828-1830)和外交大臣等重要职务。作为托利党领袖，他推动了天主教解放法案(1829)，允许天主教徒担任公职，展现了政治远见。1830年法国七月革命后，他反对议会改革，导致政治失势。尽管如此，他仍被视为国家稳定的象征，在1846年谷物法危机后重返政坛。作为军人政治家，他平衡了军事才能与政治智慧，成为英国历史上最受尊敬的政治家之一。1852年，威灵顿在伦敦逝世，国葬为他举行，葬于圣保罗大教堂。
points.descriptionEn: After Waterloo, Wellington transitioned into politics, serving as British Prime Minister (1828-1830) and Foreign Secretary. As a leader of the Tory Party, he promoted the Catholic Emancipation Act (1829), allowing Catholics to hold public office, demonstrating political foresight. Following the July Revolution in France in 1830, he opposed parliamentary reform, leading to political downfall. Despite this, he remained seen as a symbol of national stability and returned to politics during the Corn Law crisis in 1846. As a military statesman, he balanced military talent with political wisdom, becoming one of the most respected politicians in British history. In 1852, Wellington died in London and received a state funeral, buried in St. Paul's Cathedral.

supporter.zh: 威灵顿公爵被视为英国历史上最伟大的军事家和政治家之一。支持者赞扬他卓越的军事才能，特别是在半岛战争和滑铁卢战役中展现的战略智慧。他被视为国家英雄和民族象征，为英国在欧洲的地位做出了不可磨灭的贡献。作为政治家，他推动天主教解放法案，展现了开明的政治远见。他的坚韧、务实和领导力使他成为英国保守主义传统的代表人物，其军事和政治遗产至今仍影响着英国的国家认同。
supporter.en: The Duke of Wellington is regarded as one of Britain's greatest military commanders and statesmen. Supporters praise his exceptional military talent, particularly the strategic wisdom demonstrated during the Peninsular War and the Battle of Waterloo. He is celebrated as a national hero and symbol who made indelible contributions to Britain's position in Europe. As a statesman, he promoted the Catholic Emancipation Act, showing enlightened political foresight. His resilience, pragmatism, and leadership have made him a representative figure of British conservatism, and his military and political legacy continues to influence British national identity.

critic.zh: 批评者认为威灵顿过于保守和专制，特别是在政治领域。他反对议会改革，维护贵族特权，被视为阻碍民主进步的力量。在军事上，有人批评他战术过于保守，缺乏创新精神，过度依赖防御性战术。此外，他在爱尔兰问题上的立场也受到质疑，被视为殖民统治的代表人物。批评者还指出，威灵顿对新兴社会变革的抵制反映了他作为旧时代精英的局限性，难以适应19世纪欧洲快速变化的政治和社会环境。
critic.en: Critics view Wellington as overly conservative and authoritarian, particularly in his political stance. His opposition to parliamentary reform and defense of aristocratic privileges are seen as hindering democratic progress. Militarily, some criticize his tactics as too conservative and lacking innovation, with excessive reliance on defensive strategies. Additionally, his position on Irish issues is questioned, with him regarded as a representative of colonial rule. Critics also note that his resistance to emerging social changes reflects the limitations of an old-world elite struggling to adapt to the rapidly changing political and social environment of 19th-century Europe.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，威灵顿公爵被定义为一位复杂的转型人物，既是军事天才也是政治家。他代表了英国从拿破仑战争到维多利亚时代的过渡，体现了军事传统与政治变革的交织。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为威严、保守但公正的领导者形象，与拿破仑形成鲜明对比。历史学家评价他是一位实用主义者，能够根据不同环境调整策略，从印度的殖民军官到欧洲的联军统帅，再到英国的政治领袖，展现了多方面的才能。他的遗产超越了单纯的军事胜利，成为英国坚韧和实用主义的象征。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, the Duke of Wellington is defined as a complex transitional figure, both military genius and statesman. He represents Britain's transition from the Napoleonic Wars to the Victorian era, embodying the intersection of military tradition and political change. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a stern, conservative yet just leader, forming a stark contrast to Napoleon. Historians evaluate him as a pragmatist who could adapt his strategies to different environments, from colonial officer in India to allied commander in Europe to British political leader, demonstrating multifaceted talents. His legacy extends beyond mere military victory, becoming a symbol of British resilience and pragmatism.

self.zh: 战争不是靠英勇，而是靠计算取胜的。
self.en: The art of war is simple enough. Find out where your enemy is. Get at him as soon as you can. Strike him as hard as you can, and keep moving on.

others.zh: 滑铁卢战役是在伊顿公学的操场上打赢的。
others.en: The Battle of Waterloo was won on the playing fields of Eton.
others.zhSource: 通常被认为出自威灵顿公爵，但实际起源有争议
others.enSource: Often attributed to Wellington, but its actual origin is disputed
